"fr81-u251-r0132", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et changeant brusquement de conversation :", "sha256": "f4256702f7c9d0d0847ad683c5c33b15a0976ba564c497a289e787598869c83d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "tag": "prose", "text": "— Une histoire de l’autre jour. Figure-toi. Je rencontre un bourgeois. Il me fait cadeau d’un sermon et de sa bourse. Je mets ça dans ma poche. Une minute après, je fouille dans ma poche. Il n’y avait plus rien.", "sha256": "6eec845864578c2a6b781d82e0b2bed472886bb2d24ec94942aad036899ebe1d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0136", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Que le sermon, fit Gavroche.", "sha256": "039da2da274cf2169fd23ef7d225065b5d0437b97f712f5098caa9d45edcb84e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0137", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais toi, reprit Montparnasse, où vas-tu donc maintenant ?", "sha256": "4fcc2ce4f2323222517578df82233d3f71d21003475f0b3d3251b21ff32436e2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0138", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche montra ses deux protégés et dit :", "sha256": "939e1875e42aa724eaee367b589273021d1aba960c1da98e054a6d317b23e844", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0139", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je vas coucher ces enfants-là.", "sha256": "51f00b27f3e0b51cac7fd09c6c353ad824021d00d8c97a5c0e11e460f4f74ab3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0140", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où ça coucher ?", "sha256": "b5a4ee51b3658f7cebaf729342838bc85ee9786d512d81d576047ea326e9931e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0141", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Chez moi.", "sha256": "aba557381b890c205fde658246bfbe7f4a8459218c2cade6da85485e5be2458f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0142", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où ça chez toi ?", "sha256": "4ff7881507be24699a7e80859c2f7972020e7993ba73471f63f8bb44a1e12e93", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0143", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Chez moi.", "sha256": "aba557381b890c205fde658246bfbe7f4a8459218c2cade6da85485e5be2458f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0144", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tu loges donc ?", "sha256": "b7a2b6ac06d6a07b7752f328ee81641a50116b52e98e113b697324a898969c6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0145", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, je loge.", "sha256": "a27e6c2eccac81f41f3b965e7c6b0c516be654abcdfccd39c834ed47fc887b22", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0146", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et où loges-tu ?", "sha256": "5ab35f58f5e079ff2f92f98d92a2c13459cd48f3830fada166f0aa9ec89f4bf5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0147", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Dans l’éléphant, dit Gavroche.", "sha256": "64a5d205afd8968526a2194f8be6c3800afd44607d895015d4bbc5f2395456d2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0148", "tag": "prose", "text": "Montparnasse, quoique de sa nature peu étonné, ne put retenir une exclamation :", "sha256": "116659cd240f8a3a16a8bab69d714193fb8e7beca2d3935abd94e6ddb1caf04c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0149", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Dans l’éléphant !", "sha256": "f15622ac2f1501f7a9a55497ee6cbb67565a6b8b5709eaef991b06caaaf8b6ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0150", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien oui, dans l’éléphant ! repartit Gavroche. Kekçaa ?", "sha256": "10e79060e99af7e133e8e0fc725819f05488d7d80ea8bd4dd402e45a102dfb14", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0151", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ceci est encore un mot de la langue que personne n’écrit et que tout le monde parle. Kekçaa signifie : qu’est-ce que cela a ?", "sha256": "f0f8000906a2e83b694eed8a70fb4ff565d8e0e0ce3b6be97edf3324d6918987", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0152", "tag": "prose", "text": "L’observation profonde du gamin ramena Montparnasse au calme et au bon sens. Il parut revenir à de meilleurs sentiments pour le logis de Gavroche.", "sha256": "8a90c719ca062200a25a0092d83ba2acfea608060f30e9748c9d2769a8cab7bd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0153", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Au fait ! dit-il, oui, l’éléphant. Y est-on bien ?", "sha256": "fba842de5017d110238616a402daa754209f942b25745378a251aea48bcbdbe5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0154", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Très bien, fit Gavroche. Là, vrai, chenument. Il n’y a pas de vents coulis comme sous les ponts.", "sha256": "f1ba41bf8fc536e56b1d82eacfc7de01a9eb041b96b1ec6f4c823e3b4bae2f18", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0155", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment y entres-tu ?", "sha256": "51be2fee2f59f85bf1f1d1c08cf2e64ee38371ff9979cd1274b1ba8f79c1d3c5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0156", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’entre.", "sha256": "bd70f3457f066209a408766b43042fe0ad5f7f3c29fd254f1496e923c72ccbe3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0157", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il y a donc un trou ? demanda Montparnasse.", "sha256": "88ff5b21ef1468a9fb46d700f566f8c31916c286d686e75a77a1b91a4919b2e7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0158", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Parbleu ! Mais il ne faut pas le dire. C’est entre les jambes de devant. Les coqueurs[[N3]] ne l’ont pas vu.", "sha256": "7e8fc665fb7193729189e67748a24d24d9ce89104e05ed249e5a1070ab0787d3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N3]]"]}, {"id": "fr81-u251-r0159", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et tu grimpes ? Oui, je comprends.", "sha256": "f34f51bf114baf634b34ae0c0121181de17ac0cb2d18f802fbd9bb5f5cd00d65", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
